name: baccalaureat
description: Jeu du Baccalaureat (Petit Bac) multijoueur en temps reel, sans inscription.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bacc/shared && npm run build -w @bacc/server && npm run build -w @bacc/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @bacc/server" "npm run dev -w @bacc/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bacc/shared && npm run test -w @bacc/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bacc/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bacc/server && npm run typecheck -w @bacc/web
